messages:
frank: Heads-up: PM wants to replace the freeform `X-Serve-Region` header with a structured `routing.policy` JSON field in requests. Target ~6 weeks. Need SDK + console + telemetry plan.
anya: obvious billing caveat: current quota keys are constructed from header values. we need aliasing or customers will see billing gaps.
pete: console idea: add a small "Migration preview" modal that shows a sample request transformed from header -> new payload so admins can approve mappings. low-risk.
lucy: SDK strategy: implement a lightweight adapter that reads the header and injects `routing.policy` into the body for 2 releases. default enabled, then flip. emit a single startup DeprecationWarning in py and console.warn/process.emitWarning in ts. Go should expose a prometheus label.
frank: telemetry: add `routing.source` tag values ["header_v1","body_v2","proxy"]. ingestion team to run a bounded (30d) backfill to detect historical usage.
anya: quota ops: propose write-through aliasing for 45 days, then run a reconcile to merge counters. need billing owner.
pete: risk: proxies that move headers into other fields. add heuristic: compare sdk.version vs routing.source and flag mismatches as `suspected_proxy_rewrite`. include in CSV export.
lucy: python plan: release 1.2.0 adapter with env var `REDWOOD_PREFER_NEW_ROUTING=1` to test. 1.3.0 flips default off. include `--simulate-policy` flag for SEs.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: feature/routing-body-adapter -> canary 2024-05-28 01:00 UTC :calendar:
frank: console telemetry: add a small dashboard tile showing top 10 tenants still using header_v1 and inbound API key hashes. ops wants week-over-week delta.
anya: docs: add envoy filter snippets and migration snippets for nginx/express. also a recommended rollback snippet.
pete: timeline draft: week0 announce; week1 telemetry + console preview; week2-5 SDK adapters; week6 flip defaults; week8 stop accepting header with 2-week rollback window.
lucy: add unit tests asserting `routing.source` emitted correctly and integration tests for the adapter.
frank: I'll own comms + checklist. creating follow-ups. thanks all. :thumbsup:
